problem: Local persistence, public rendering, GitHub source access, mirroring, and same-provider CI reads have been used as evidence for some properties but are not independently proven cold survivability. Require placement/recovery gates at source creation and before publication, not only at deletion.

typed_relations.CoFed+: An authorized relation among eligible custodians, administrators and failure domains. Discovery or copying does not imply federation of trust or consent.
typed_relations.CoDura+: Evidence-qualified survival of exact editions through declared failures, including independent restore of source bytes and rights metadata. A named destination does not confer durability.
typed_relations.CoOwm+_Commons_20261111: Shared-stewardship research direction; no legal ownership or license transfer by name or advisory.
typed_relations.CoOwm+_GestureCandidate: Deliberate narrative-to-WorkID ownership/continuity gesture. Spelling/semantic identity unresolved. Not silently identical to commons stewardship.
typed_relations.CoCiv+: Candidate civic governance relation: participation and voluntary contribution are distinct from author permission, copyright and publication authority.
typed_relations.CoOS+_candidate: Candidate OS/storage enforcement adapter, not an asserted implemented kernel or service.
typed_relations.CoStax+_candidate: Candidate storage/service layer mapping; individual copies and stacks do not establish independent recovery.
typed_relations.CoPublication+: Versioned editorial lineage with source identity, history, rights and reader correction, not a storage substitute.
typed_relations.CoCoCopy+: Source-linked continuity and revision event projection, not full source custody.

UNKNOWN.require: No public projection, license or retention inferred

inverted_failure_tests: X2 lost and CoStead reachable only from X2 -> not independent recovery
NAS and X2 share power/keys/admin or one site -> copies exist but federation independent claim held
Two different cloud brands share one SSO/credential or billing account -> common-mode candidate
GitHub removed and Substack post remains -> published projection may lack exact source/asset/edit history
Substack deleted and GitHub markdown survives -> published format, comments, subscriber consent and old reader URLs may be lost
GitHub repo readable but only at moving main ref -> not immutable edition preservation
Public article corrected and original overwritten -> historic citation cannot be reproduced
Same article listed twice under distinct titles -> two labels not two independent works
Mirror updates stale or wrong article/rights -> replication can amplify corruption
CC0/CC license assumed from public access -> rights falsely promoted
Private unclassified draft auto-mirrored to commons -> privacy and rights breach
Independent copy exists but restore credentials stored solely on X2 -> no device-independent restore
No matching archive entry -> may mean missing inventory, not source absent
A successful checksum but failed image/license/alt-text restoration -> incomplete edition recovery
CoOwm shared-stewardship and CoOwm gesture labels merged -> false consent/authority inheritance

bounded_turtle_review.stop_rule: Stop only at a tested independent trust/recovery root or HOLD with explicit missing evidence; do not recursively spawn storage authorities or checks without added information.
bounded_turtle_review.next_deed: Prove cold restore for one existing PUBLIC_SAFE article edition, excluding the publisher/GitHub and originating device, then compare exact text, assets, rights record and published references.
